description: Issue #286 review round 2: whole-query witnesses cannot replace a cached prefix answer.
grammar:
%rule text A B
%rule r A
%check c1 #·text
%conditions $.onward.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token.preceding-tokens)
%warning "c1"
%check c2 #·text
%conditions $.onward.parse(r).ending-after($.first-token.preceding-tokens)
%warning "c2"
%check c3 #·text
%conditions $.onward.parse(r …).ending-after($.first-token.preceding-tokens)
%warning "c3"
